why: Structure signal at 0.72 clears the 0.60 provisional floor and sets a bullish envelope.
Participation is a different signal family at 0.61, so it is a non-duplicative confirmation rather than a restatement of price.
The opposing volatility signal at 0.34 is below the 0.70 veto threshold, so it is recorded as counter-evidence rather than a refusal.
The 8-DTE and 50-DTE expirations are outside the provisional 14-45 band; the 655 strike is excluded because its quote is too wide.
Long 640 is the only contract with delta inside the 0.55-0.70 long band; 645 and 650 sit inside the 0.25-0.40 short band.

Width 5.00 clears the minimum width floor of 0.5% of spot (3.21). The 640/650 pair is also eligible but is wider, and the narrowest eligible width is preferred because it carries the smallest maximum loss.

Debit is the conservative 12.60 ask minus the 9.60 bid = 3.00, a debit/width ratio of 0.60 at the limit, so the structure clears the screen. Half of each leg's own quoted width is then added as an execution allowance ((0.20 + 0.20) / 2 = 0.20), giving the 3.20 the order is actually bid at and the 320.00 maximum loss risk must approve against a 500.00 budget at 0.5% of 100000 equity.

The structural debit/width screen reads the quoted market and the allowance does not enter it, so the same spread is judged the same way whichever feed is quoting it; the allowance moves only the price bid and the loss approved.
